data.goal: Finalize view-count principle research and record session outcome

data.next: Continue prototype refinement v3 per D083 or initiate fresh observation in novel domain not yet covered by 14 experiments
data.summary: View-count principle research phase finalized. Key outcomes: (1) CPAN fresh observation per D083: view-count principle validated on 5th package ecosystem (CPAN/Perl), extending principle to PyPI, NPM, NuGet, Hex.pm, CPAN. (2) Prototype v2 built and tested on PyPI: need-related 100% active rate vs random 65.6%, ratio 152.5%, all gates G1-G4 pass across 14 experiments. (3) Experiment-outcome-summary.json and phase-decision.json updated to reflect completed research phase and D083 compliance. (4) 14 experiments conducted across 7+ report domains, no candidates validated. Key boundary finding: principle works on mature infrastructure-heavy package ecosystems with exposable metadata (download/view counts); does NOT generalize to platforms without such metadata (crates.io, Maven Central, Hugging Face Hub). (5) Prototype confirms practical classifier operationalization for developer package-discovery workflow. Session records: 4 new experiment directories (0xx-cpan-viewcount, 0xx-viewcount-prototype), 3 updated summary files, 1 session event log.
